name: StyleSetterBase
signature: public abstract class StyleSetterBase<T> : IStyleSetter<T> where T : StyleSetterBase<T>

docs.summary: Base class for fluent style-builder types. Provides chainable methods that set UI properties on the wrapped element and return the derived type T so callers can continue the builder pattern.

Blurs whatever is rendered behind this element (frosted glass / backdrop blur), with the given radius in pixels. Combine with a translucent [`BackgroundColor`](#api~Prowl.PaperUI.StyleSetterBase~BackgroundColor) for a tint. A radius of 0 disables it. Requires a renderer backend with backdrop blur support.

Anchors a SelfDirected element to its parent's left content edge. Auto is unanchored.
Anchors a SelfDirected element to its parent's right content edge. Auto is unanchored.
Anchors a SelfDirected element to its parent's top content edge. Auto is unanchored.
Anchors a SelfDirected element to its parent's bottom content edge. Auto is unanchored. Anchoring both edges of an axis stretches the element across it.

The element's own outer spacing on each side, mapping to the [`Left`](#api~Prowl.PaperUI.GuiProp~Left)/[`Right`](#api~Prowl.PaperUI.GuiProp~Right)/[`Top`](#api~Prowl.PaperUI.GuiProp~Top)/[`Bottom`](#api~Prowl.PaperUI.GuiProp~Bottom) style properties. Auto means no margin. Use the parent's padding for a uniform inset and its [`Gap`](#api~Prowl.PaperUI.StyleSetterBase~Gap) for the space between siblings.

A stretch value makes the edge a flexible spacer that competes for leftover space, which is how a single element is centered or pushed without a wrapper.
